candidates.change_summary: Delete the require statement so anyone can call withdrawAll, changing the observable behavior when a non-owner calls the function.
Replace `payable(_recipient)` with `payable(msg.sender)`, changing the recipient of the withdrawn funds.
Replace `address(this).balance` with `address(this).balance - 1`, changing the transferred amount.
Insert `selfdestruct(payable(msg.sender));` before the transfer, which changes the behavior by destroying the contract and sending funds differently.
